main_text.head: Ad lanceam.
main_text.p: Ave ferrum triumphale, Intrans pectus tu vitale. Cœli pandis ostia. | Facundata in cruore, Felix hasta, nos, amore Per te fixi, fauci{a}, &c.
main_text.head: AD SANCTUM SUDARIUM CHRISTI.

p.i: Cadurei Portugalenses vicini gloriantur de particulâ Sudarii Christi. In horum processio- nali extant hæ preces, quas decantare solent:
De eadem: Sudarium Christi liberet nos, à peste, & à morte tristi.

Oratio: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui in memoriam passionis unigeniti filii tui, sanctam ejus sindonem, cum expresså ipsius effigie, venerandam reliquisti in terris, tribue, quæsumus, ut per virtutem ejusdem sanctæ sindonis faciem tuam contemplari merea- tur in cœlis.

main_text.head: PROSA.
main_text.l: Plaudat cœli hierarchia, | Granum tegit palea,
Nova fonat harmonia, | Radix Christus dum marcescit,
Novo ducta cantico, | Ramus homo tunc surescit,
Huic concordans in hac via, | Salva Dei idea,
Lauder promat Ecclesia, | Gaude felix Sabauda,
Sindon, per quam gaudia, | Nova laudis gloria.
Felix jam Ecclesia | Artus fracti solidantur,
Deum Sindon contegit, | Rea pete suffragiat,

page.notes: Verse lines were set in two columns; the pairing of the Prosa lines is reconstructed from the layout. Some words are faint and marked with [?] where uncertain. The final line is partly obscured at the foot.
